texts: Added data for both Haute Coutoure identities. Initial identity data was added first, then facades, clash arena support, and others were added later.
Encounters for Part 1 have been added.
Added support for levels 61-65 and the luxcavations to the training calculator.
Changed the labels from you/enemy to player/target in clash arena to reduce potential confusion among players.
Fixed a bug that caused the clash/damage calculator display type on builds to not display the numbers properly.
